• Main idea Dijkstra:
• P(v) upper bound of the shortest path from s to v
• d(v): weight of P(v)
• p(v): predecessor of v on P(v)
• Initialization
• Upper bound improvement
• If there exists a node u such that d(v) > d(u) + w(u, v) then update:
• d(v) = d(u) + w(u, v)
• p(v) = u
